_doc: What a real api call costs, for the spend ledger (lib/ai/budget.ts; improvement plan 'Money guardrails', layer 2; issue #19). US dollars per million tokens, copied from Anthropic's pricing page (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing) on checkedOn, for global inference (no inference_geo: US-only inference costs 1.1x). Every rate needs at most 3 decimal places (budget.ts counts in billionths of a dollar per token). A model not listed here can't be budgeted, so a real call to it is refused; the same ID with an 8-digit date suffix (e.g. -20261001) matches its entry. longPrompt: a request whose prompt (input plus cache reads plus cache writes) is over overInputTokens pays that rate card for all of its tokens, output included. Update checkedOn whenever a rate changes.
